name: astercaeser
description: Connect Codex to a scoped AsterCaeser instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped AsterCaeser tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to AsterCaeser through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so AsterCaeser Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AsterCaeser only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
